title: Isotopes of chlorine
caption: Chlorine-35 and chlorine-37 both have 17 protons and 17 electrons arranged 2, 8, 7, so they react the same way. Only the neutrons differ: 18 against 20.
alt: Two chlorine atoms side by side with identical electron shells 2, 8, 7; one nucleus has 17 protons and 18 neutrons, the other 17 protons and 20 neutrons.
description: Left: chlorine-35, nucleus 17 p and 18 n, electrons 2, 8, 7.
Right: chlorine-37, nucleus 17 p and 20 n, electrons 2, 8, 7.
Nuclide symbols above each: ³⁵₁₇Cl and ³⁷₁₇Cl.
